articles.summary: In early June, Delta Faucet Company held a day of service in which their employees volunteered for a variety of community-oriented activities. At Delta Faucet Company headquarters in Indianapolis, employees worked with Greater Indy Habitat for Humanity to construct wall panels, which will be assembled into a home for a local family. “This marks our 25th year partnering with Habitat for Humanity and the 25th home our employees are helping to build. Our partnership has provided meaningful opportunities for our employees to volunteer and make a lasting positive impact in the community,” said Jill Ehnes, President at Delta Faucet Company. Other…
articles.title: Delta Faucet Company Celebrates Day of Service
